job.label: Short bow — Relic
job.keep_line: the same single short deep D-curved ash bow, upper nock at upper-left and lower nock at lower-right of its gentle diagonal, thick short limbs tapering to rounded nocks, broad spirally rawhide-wrapped grip on the curved right side and a single straight taut dark string closing the D on the left. Preserve the exact limb curvature, wood facets, nock-end cord bindings, rawhide overlaps, open interior and string endpoints; the nocks do not curl or reflex. Pale ash and natural tan rawhide, no coloured maker accent. No arrow, quiver or added hardware.
job.prompt:
Create the Relic-finish cosmetic variant of the attached fictional RPG short bow inventory painting for Project Heaven Cry. This is a 2D digital game-art asset. FIRST attachment fixes Standard geometry and registration: a single deep D-shaped short bow, rounded nocks at upper-left and lower-right, broad spiral grip wrap on the curved right side, straight taut string closing the D on the left. Preserve exact limb curvature, every opening, nock/string endpoints, grip overlaps, pose, scale, camera and margins. SECOND is the preceding grade: retain its additions except the current material changes. THIRD is Heavenprint brushwork reference only, never a person or scene.

Grade: Relic. Keep the shape and the inlay. The wood and leather darken to a deep warm sheen with age, the inlay to dull old gold, and one small flush gilt ferrule sits on the grip (on the quiver, on the strap buckle). Add one old repair that tells a story: a limb bound with old sinew at one point, a crossbow stock pinned with a brass plate, or a quiver seam re-stitched in an older thread. A string is darker and old but taut.

Keep both prior inlay routes and nock caps; age the inlay to dull old gold and the wood/leather to deep warm oiled sheen, no rust. Add ONE short old sinew binding on the existing lower limb, flush inside its exact original contour, and ONE tiny flush gilt ferrule on the existing grip. The repaired binding is a surface treatment, not a new lump or projection. Preserve the taut string and all prior parts. Apply this grade only to the actual bow parts shown; no stock, quiver, arrow, added fittings or extra object. No curled/reflexed tips. Do not add, remove, resize or move any part or opening. Hand-painted opaque gouache and ink with broken directional strokes, selective dry-brush, charcoal shadows, warm ivory focal edges and upper-left light. Full transparent background,1024x1024RGBA, same framing and at least50px clear margin. No cast shadow, ground, scene, figure, hand, text, letters, numbers, logo, label, frame or border. Exterior painted illustration only, no diagram, measurements, assembly steps or operating instructions.
